newsitem.title: GREECE: Olympic Airways launches flights to Budapest.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Airways launches flights to Budapest.

text.p: Greece's state carrier Olympic Airways will launch a service to Budapest on June 22 with five flights linking Athens to the Hungarian capital on Boeing 737-200 aircraft weekly, it said on Friday.
Olympic, which celebrates its 40th birthday, said it was continuing to expand its network beyond the 40 international and 38 domestic destinations it currently serves.

"After the addition of flights to Bucharest, Belgrade and Moscow, Olympic Airways is plesed to announce the launch of service to yet another romantic destination in eastern Europe: Budapest," it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
